title: shipping-service crash due to gradual memory leak
summary: shipping-service began crashing with OutOfMemoryError roughly every 6 hours after a deployment that added an in-memory result cache. The cache had no eviction policy, so it grew unbounded until the process ran out of heap space.
root_cause: A newly introduced LRU cache implementation was missing its max-size configuration, so it accepted unlimited entries instead of evicting old ones.
fix: Set an explicit max_size and TTL on the cache, and added a dashboard panel tracking heap usage over time to catch slow leaks before they cause a crash.
